entries.stanceLine: Breakouts suspect in both directions today — 104% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.

signals.text: 104% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.
Sterling is at the 100th percentile of its 20-day range and still rising — a persistent FX headwind capping upside breaks (weak GBP is what lifts FTSE).
ORB break UP is aligned with the BULLISH macro bias (+3) — continuation has the backdrop behind it.
FTSE is tracking a firmer European tape (Euro Stoxx +2.27%) — the cross-market lean is up.
Past 13:30 with US futures +1.48% — the 14:30 US handoff argues for holding longs into the US open.
US CPI prints tomorrow 13:30 GMT — late-session moves today are as likely pre-event de-risking as conviction.
